name: Fizigui
note: OCHA July 2024 administrative map explicitly labels the settlement near the southern provincial boundary; the corresponding GeoNames Fizigi point (6843766) matches the named pin rather than the formerly selected GeoNames homonym near Moussoro. The 2026 research map places a similarly named feature farther west; retain the OCHA-confirmed representative point and note the disagreement. https://www.unocha.org/attachments/45bdb06d-a4f2-4a1e-adbe-f63554da2c3d/TCD_MAP_DecoupageAdministratif_20240723.pdf https://content.scirp.org/pdf/as_3005224.pdf#page=3

name: Dolock
note: The 2026 field-survey administrative map, based on the July 2024 territorial reform, names Dolock in the southern part of East Barh El Gazel rather than the GeoNames homonym north near Moussoro. The south OSM populated-place point is independently corroborated by the GeoNames and HDX Dalok settlement. https://content.scirp.org/pdf/as_3005224.pdf#page=3 https://www.geonames.org/2434271 https://data.humdata.org/dataset/chad-populated-places-settlements

name: Eberia
note: The 2026 field-survey administrative map explicitly names Eberia in East Barh El Gazel (southern end of the department). HDX public settlement list and GeoNames identify the southern namesake Ebéria Broua, distinct from northern Eberia Djemil; OSM settlement point is used as a representative point, not an independently verified precise municipal-office location. https://content.scirp.org/pdf/as_3005224.pdf#page=3 https://www.geonames.org/2432992 https://data.humdata.org/dataset/chad-populated-places-settlements
